skins.name: A Silvern Caress On the Flow of Time
skins.code: "Nine-Colored Deer" Collaborative Series/A Silvern Caress On the Flow of Time
skins.description: Crossing the golden sands yet leaving nary a trace, time passes quietly along with the moon's shadow. Nine-Colored Deer meticulously counts the tracks left behind by the passing years, and thus the full moon pauses, seeking one to converse with.
